description: Anytime order check. POST /api/getOrderHistory with per-request X-MBX-APIKEY. Full order history, or one order's history with optional orderId. Requires a trade-scoped API key (same scope as quote_trade_place_order). Read-only: no live trading action.

orderId.description: Optional order id to narrow to one order's history. Omit for the full order history.

name: quote_trade_get_order_history

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

title: Quote.Trade order history
